GENTEXT/SITUATION/In support of CJCS 2-18, region four Army and Air  
Force MARS will support DOD COMEX 22-1.//  
GENTEXT/MISSION/MARS Auxiliarists will activate the RJMOG and  
execute DOD COMEX 22-1 from 1601Z on 18 Feb 2020 through 2359Z on 21  
Feb 2022.//  
GENTEXT/EXECUTION/Tasks for this exercise will include:  
a) Call-up/rally/staging procedures  
b) Monitoring of specific DOD calling channels  
c) Activation of the region four RJMOG  
d) Respond to requests for information (RI)  
e) Liaise with AUXCOM resources to fulfill RIs  
f) Train on NCS and message relay procedures  
  
Auxiliarists should prepare by ensuring station hardware and  
software are properly configured and operating within required  
parameters.  Members are reminded to delete existing strip  
definitions from the Response Collector and Message Creator  
applications.  This will help  
ensure stations are using the latest strips issued during the  
exercise.  A webinar to discuss the OPORD will be held on 15 Feb  
2022 at 0001  
Zulu.  The link to access the webinar is included in the forthcoming  
OPORD.  All members are encouraged to attend.//  
AKNLDG/NO/-//
